experiment: Prospective genuine ManiSkill Panda PhysX frozen PPO same-seed comparison under one explicit target-arm hold and unknown ACK at t=2.

methods.strict: only common exact native target from all belief candidates, else count refusal as failure
methods.robust_no_query: compute common position/SO3 minimax action from both action-history hypotheses; issue only if trust, representability and both setpoint budgets pass; else refuse
methods.robust_then_query: attempt exactly same robust no-query; if refuses and unused one read remains, call controller true target readback ONCE, reset belief, then compute projected exact-memory target command
methods.always_query: take one privileged native controller target read after the uncertain fault, regardless of geometric ambiguity
methods.optimistic: assume requested action executed despite physically injected zero arm delta
methods.oracle: read actual privileged target memory throughout all decisions

primary_outcome: On each of the 16 prespecified states: true official info.success ever by horizon 50 for all seven paired arms, plus selective query count and robust/no-query authorization breakdown.
secondary_outcome: Paired difference versus optimistic and mandatory single privileged readback; no effect-size significance claim beyond sample.
not_claimed: unprivileged readback when privileged controller state used
